policy.real_data_scope: one-seed exploratory process and attribution evidence only

execution_contract.deferred_reason: The local GPU is reserved for another task by explicit user instruction.

G1.label: ela-gpu-gate
pass_if: the source-bound wrapper receipt has status passed and exact command bash scripts/check.sh gpu
the GPU gate exits with code 0
the execution receipt and G2 report identify the same frozen source manifest

G2.label: ela-cuda-completion-profile
pass_if: status equals completed
failures is empty
device.actual is cuda and every one of the five lanes has status completed
every lane gate has passed=true
prepared graph identity, immutable packed-template reuse, and unsealed DLPack alias invalidation checks pass
grouped-MM relative-error, dispatch, call-count, and frozen latency checks pass
direct-CSR topology equality and output-error checks pass
Triton complete-family dispatch, output, input-gradient, and parameter-gradient checks pass
compiled-core cold/warm/topology graph-count, no-fallback, numerical, and frozen latency checks pass
every lane maximum timed peak allocation is strictly below 16 GiB
the report verifies the frozen source manifest against current bytes

G3.label: ela-qm9-screen
pass_if: status equals completed and all four expected arms completed exactly 100 updates
static_initial_predictions_identical is true
every evaluation count is positive and MAE/RMSE are finite
the stagewise arm is explicitly labelled as a separate non-schema-paired functionality arm
the stagewise coordinate parameter hash changes and final coordinate displacement is finite and nonzero
processed_monolith_including_test_labels_loaded is truthfully true
test_indices_indexed, test_labels_used, and test_evaluated are false
the fixed split hashes and source receipt are present
G3.interpretation: functionality and short-run attribution screen; no convergence or accuracy-win claim

G4.label: ela-lba-overfit-screen
pass_if: status equals completed and all four expected arms completed exactly 250 updates
static_initial_predictions_identical is true
each arm final full-set evaluation normalized_mse is lower than its initial_evaluation normalized_mse on the same 16 complexes
every train evaluation count is 16 and MAE/RMSE are finite
only the train split was opened
test shard and test label storage remain unused by this run while historical local test materialization is disclosed
test labels, test indices, and test evaluation all remain unused
G4.interpretation: train-only capacity evidence; no validation, generalization, or lane-superiority claim

G5.label: ela-lba-id30-screen
pass_if: status equals completed and all four expected arms completed exactly 220 updates
static_initial_predictions_identical is true
every validation evaluation count is positive and MAE/RMSE are finite
the split kind is official_ID30_train_validation and both train_limited and validation_limited are false
separate train/validation identity and topology receipts are present
the frozen identity gate confirms 3507 train, 466 validation, and 32302952 directed edges
only train and val were opened
test shard and test label storage remain unused by this run while historical local test materialization is disclosed
test labels, test indices, and test evaluation all remain unused
G5.interpretation: one-seed validation process and attribution evidence; no untouched-test or accuracy-win claim

G6.label: ela-completion-adjudication
pass_if: the packet contains exactly ordered G1 through G6 jobs
the G6 command embeds the exact frozen full-source and real-data source hashes
G1 through G5 commands match their packet argv exactly
all source, timing, resource, topology, access, pairing, and update-count checks are recomputed from receipts
the final status equals passed
G6.interpretation: fail-closed mechanical postprocess; it cannot promote a failed or missing execution

final_labels.pass: all declared receipt and frozen gate conditions hold
final_labels.null: execution is valid but an architecture effect is absent or inconclusive
final_labels.fail: execution is valid and a preregistered gate fails
final_labels.invalid_receipt: required provenance, access, finite metric, arm, or update evidence is missing
